summary.text: Maria Horn represents Connecticut's 64th Assembly District, which covers nine towns in the state's northwest corner, and was first elected in 2018.

paragraphs.text: A native of Ohio, she earned a B.A. from Princeton University in 1986 and a J.D. from the University of Chicago Law School in 1993.
She worked in corporate finance at JP Morgan & Co. and later as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in the Criminal Division of the Southern District of New York.
She lives in Salisbury, where she served on the Board of Finance.
